name: net_back_plate_after_a_rejoin
description: Tamsin's window loses its link for 7 s, long enough for her seat to go AWAY. It reconnects, rejoins and catches up; the caretaker still holds her seat until the next build window, and the plate says so (Welcome back, the caretaker hands back after this wave or the coming one), as it does after another tab. An order she gives meanwhile is refused for that, before any gold check, not with 'Not enough gold'. The window hands the seat back and the plate goes.

steps.msg: the caretaker still holds her seat

steps.assert: scene.overlay().state == 5 and scene.overlay().visible and scene.overlay().lines()[0] == 'Welcome back' and scene.overlay().lines()[1].begins_with('The caretaker hands back after ')
steps.msg: back in the match: the plate says the caretaker hands back at the next window

steps.assert: scene.controller.mode == '' and node('Notice').text == 'The caretaker hands back at the next build window'
steps.msg: an order meanwhile is refused for the caretaker, not for the gold

steps.assert: Game.order_refusal() == 'The caretaker hands back at the next build window' and Game.accepts_commands()
steps.msg: the match runs and the link holds; only the seat is not hers yet
handed back: the plate goes and her orders go out
